mechanism_narrative: The observed consistent upward trend in RETAIL_REC mobility over the past four weeks indicates a sustained recovery in consumer activity, which will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in time spent at residential locations, as indicated by RESIDENTIAL mobility falling below 15% from baseline, suggests increased out-of-home activity that will directly translate to higher retail and recreation visits over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL falls below 15% from baseline, but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the subsequent two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The combined increase in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility indicates a broader return to daily routines and commuting, which, when coupled, will significantly boost retail and recreation activity as people integrate shopping and leisure into their commutes over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue their upward trend, but RETAIL_REC does not show an increase over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of easing public health restrictions, the recent rebound in PARKS mobility suggests a general increase in comfort with outdoor public spaces, which will spill over into increased retail and recreation visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS mobility continues its upward trend in an easing restrictions regime, but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent week-on-week increase in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, reflecting essential out-of-home trips, establishes a baseline of public movement that will gradually extend to non-essential retail and recreation, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM mobility continues to increase, but RETAIL_REC does not show an upward trend over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES mobility surpasses a -30% change from baseline, it signifies a critical mass of people returning to their offices, leading to increased demand for nearby retail and recreation options during lunch breaks and after work, boosting RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES mobility rises above -30% from baseline, but RETAIL_REC does not increase in the subsequent week.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PARKS and a decrease in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates a strong shift towards out-of-home activities, suggesting that people are increasingly comfortable venturing out, which will directly benefit retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS mobility increases while RESIDENTIAL mobility decreases, but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of sustained public health awareness, a continued high level of RESIDENTIAL mobility (above 15% from baseline) despite other categories rising, suggests a lingering caution that will suppress the full recovery of RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above 15% from baseline, but RETAIL_REC shows a significant increase over the next 28 days.
